mapper.sql: ID, JOB_CODE, JOB_NAME, APPLICATION_NAME, HANDLER_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SCHEDULE_TYPE, CRON_EXPRESSION, INTERVAL_SECONDS, START_AT, TIME_ZONE, MISFIRE_POLICY, CONCURRENCY_POLICY, TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_ATTEMPTS, RETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS, PARAMETERS_JSON, STATE, SCHEDULE_VERSION, SYNC_STATUS, LAST_SYNC_ERROR, NEXT_FIRE_TIME, LAST_FIRE_TIME, VERSION, CREATOR_ID, CREATED_TIME, MODIFIER_ID, MODIFY_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PEACH_SCHEDULER_JOB WHERE ID = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_SCHEDULER_JOB (ID, JOB_CODE, JOB_NAME, APPLICATION_NAME, HANDLER_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SCHEDULE_TYPE, CRON_EXPRESSION, INTERVAL_SECONDS, START_AT, TIME_ZONE, MISFIRE_POLICY, CONCURRENCY_POLICY, TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_ATTEMPTS, RETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS, PARAMETERS_JSON, STATE, SCHEDULE_VERSION, SYNC_STATUS, VERSION, CREATOR_ID, CREATED_TIME, MODIFIER_ID, MODIFY_TIME) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobCode}, #{jobName}, #{applicationName}, #{handlerName}, #{description}, #{scheduleType}, #{cronExpression}, #{intervalSeconds}, #{startAt}, #{timeZone}, #{misfirePolicy}, #{concurrencyPolicy}, #{timeoutMs}, #{maxAttempts}, #{retryIntervalSeconds}, #{parametersJson}, #{state}, #{scheduleVersion}, #{syncStatus}, #{version}, #{creatorId}, NOW(3), #{modifierId}, NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_SCHEDULER_JOB SET JOB_NAME = #{jobName}, APPLICATION_NAME = #{applicationName}, HANDLER_NAME = #{handlerName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{scheduleType}, CRON_EXPRESSION = #{cronExpression}, INTERVAL_SECONDS = #{intervalSeconds}, START_AT = #{startAt}, TIME_ZONE = #{timeZone}, MISFIRE_POLICY = #{misfirePolicy}, CONCURRENCY_POLICY = #{concurrencyPolicy}, TIMEOUT_MS = #{timeoutMs}, MAX_ATTEMPTS = #{maxAttempts}, RETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS = #{retryIntervalSeconds}, PARAMETERS_JSON = #{parametersJson}, SCHEDULE_VERSION = SCHEDULE_VERSION + 1, SYNC_STATUS = 'PENDING', LAST_SYNC_ERROR = NULL, VERSION = VERSION + 1, MODIFIER_ID = #{modifierId}, MODIFY_TIME = NOW(3) WHERE ID = #{id} AND VERSION = #{version} AND STATE <> 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PEACH_SCHEDULER_JOB WHERE SYNC_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY MODIFY_TIME ASC LIMIT #{limit}
